attributes.additional_details: sometimes i fancy a takeaway but the current prices are extortionate. wetherspoons combines good food with cheap prices and letting us order it on deliveroo would be the icing on top of the cake. think of the profits Mr JD wetherspoon and delivery apps will make. it also increases the amount of jobs available since there will be a higher demand for delivery drivers.
attributes.background: Wetherspoons is a human right and when the weather is awful, I cant be bothered to go out in the cold and rain, especially when I'm in my PJs. imagine being able to get a spice bag or a boneless basket delivered straight to your door.
